headline: The Bascom Group Secures $62.5 Million Refinancing for Denver Multifamily Asset
summary: The Bascom Group completed a $62.5 million refinancing of Viceroy Observatory Park, a 275-unit multifamily community in Denver, Colorado. Bascom previously acquired the property in May 2018 for $92.5 million.
why: The Bascom Group is a private equity real estate investment firm. Multifamily debt refinancings reflect prevailing credit conditions and liquidity in the commercial property sector.

impacts.name: The Bascom Group
impacts.why: The Bascom Group completed a $62.5 million debt refinancing for its multifamily residential community.
